cds.title: University of Houston-Downtown Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (profile, student-faculty ratio, programs, fall 2024)

stats.notes: CDS C1 residency split (fall 2025): in-state 7,215 / out-of-state 91 / international 49 applicants; admitted 6,347 / 79 / 39; enrolled 1,165 / 7 / 13. Undergraduate enrollment 12,441 and nonresident undergraduates 229 are the CDS B1 'Total Undergraduates' figures (fall 2025); the student-faculty ratio (18:1) is the fall 2024 College Navigator figure because the CDS ratio could not be read. No waiting list, no early decision or early action. UHD is test-optional, so SAT/ACT percentiles describe the 60% (SAT) and 4% (ACT) of enrollees who submitted scores.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8F: 'UHD freshman applicants have the option to apply for admission with or without a SAT and/or ACT test score ... The test optional policy applies to both domestic and international freshman students.' Freshman-transfer and GED/homeschool applicants are not eligible to be test optional.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (2025-26, first-year): non-resident tuition $19,583 plus required fees $1,456. UHD has no on-campus housing; the room-and-board figure is the food and housing estimate for commuters not living at home. G5 also lists transportation $3,016. College Navigator (2024-25) showed out-of-state tuition and fees $17,548 and out-of-state off-campus total cost of attendance $36,964.
